name: メッセージ再通知の時刻候補
prompt:
Create one high-fidelity Japanese iOS Slack reminder bottom-sheet component, matching the attached source crop and Japanese native preview. The assigned crop is exactly the modal from its rounded top corners through the 「日時を指定」 row; it does not include the dimmed Slack message background above.

Use a clean white sheet with softly rounded top corners, a centered short light-gray drag handle, a thin pale divider under the title, and six left-aligned option rows. Target canvas is 390×306 (about 1.275:1 landscape). Keep the title bold and options regular, in Meiryo: title 「リマインダーを設定」; then, exactly:
「30分後」
「1時間後」
「3時間後」
「明日の9:00」
「月曜日の9:00」
Add a thin divider before the final option 「日時を指定」.

Use near-black #1D1D1D text, #D7D7D7 handle, and very light gray #E4E4E4 separators. Keep the generous source row spacing, the modal's white surface, exact Japanese glyphs, and source crop's framing. No extra content, message background, status bar, bottom action button, picker wheel, footer, brand or watermark.

All six options and the title are plain text inside a selection sheet; there are no hyperlinks in this assigned component, so keep them dark. The word 「Youtube」 is a blue actual hyperlink in the full reference screenshot above the sheet, outside this component crop; do not bring that off-crop background text into the isolated modal. If a wider screen context is ever included, preserve that actual hyperlink in blue.
reviewNotes: Candidate 1 needs the source divider beneath the heading and slightly narrower drag handle; two attempts remain one.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
